nodes.label: S-180 Gate: 0.5.3 Web Filter Debounce and DOM Reuse
150ms Debounced Keyed DOM Reconcile and First-Paint-Only Cascade
nodes.rationale: Replaces full ~390-row list rebuilds per keystroke with a 150ms trailing debounce, signature-keyed row reconciliation (rowSignature), User Timing instrumentation (skills-ui:filter-render ~0.9-1.0 ms median), and first-paint-only .rise-in entrance cascade so animation replays drop from 10 to 0 while keeping first-load animation and row focus.
